messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Security & Privacy + Telemetry questions

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Summary of what we discussed:
- Acme Health is evaluating Redwood Inference to power clinical summarization and triage features.
- Key concerns: HIPAA/BAA requirements, SOC 2 evidence, and telemetry/privacy controls for both the console and the docs/tracking on public pages.

Open items / asks for your team:
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether you require an active Type II report or if a Type I/attestation is acceptable during procurement? We can share our SOC 2 summary and carve-outs.
2) HIPAA & BAA: confirm the contracting owner we should loop in (you mentioned procurement). We can start a BAA conversation in parallel.
3) Vendor security questionnaire: I’m attaching a fillable questionnaire for your team to complete and returning to us helps speed legal review (or feel free to send your standard questionnaire).
4) Telemetry & cookies: a couple of quick product questions so we can confirm compliance posture — please see the questions below and let us know any must-have constraints:
   - Do you require that all console telemetry be scrubbed of any PHI/PII at collection (we default to not storing PII, but want to confirm controls)?
   - Are there specific retention windows required for logs/audit trails?
   - For the public docs site: are there any restrictions on analytics/cookie vendors (GA, Segment, Hotjar, etc.)?

Next steps I propose:
- Please return the attached questionnaire (or your standard questionnaire) to procurement@acmehealth.com and cc me.
- I’ll loop in Ethan (solutions) to provide technical details on telemetry, retention, and redaction controls this week.
- Tentatively schedule a 30-min procurement + security sync next week — what days work best for your team?

Attachments: Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Fillable.pdf

If helpful, here are quick links to our docs on SOC 2 and telemetry: https://docs.redwood.com/security/soc2 and https://docs.redwood.com/platform/telemetry

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,

From: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@acmehealth.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & Privacy + Telemetry questions

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the questionnaire. A few quick answers from our side:
- SOC 2: Procurement will prefer a current Type II report if available, but we can accept a Type I + roadmap if that speeds up review. Please send any SOC 2 summary docs and timeline for Type II (if Type I is current).
- HIPAA / BAA: We do require a BAA for production PHI. I copied procurement on this thread — they will coordinate legal.
- Telemetry / privacy: Our baseline requirements are that PHI/PII must not be stored in logs or telemetry by default. We do allow telemetry that is aggregated and pseudonymized for performance/health metrics. Retention: default 90 days for logs, 1 year for audit trails unless otherwise negotiated.
- Docs analytics: procurement/security will want to confirm analytics vendors; GA/Segment are typically allowed but we’ll escalate if the vendor stores any user-level PII.

I’ve attached our vendor questionnaire — we completed the administrative fields and left technical questions for Redwood to fill (separate PDF). We’ll review your SOC 2 summary once you send it.

Attachment: Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Fillable.pdf

Regards,
Claire Zhao
Director, IT Security | Acme Health
claire.zhao@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & Privacy + Telemetry questions

Claire — thanks for the quick replies and for sending back the questionnaire. Attaching our SOC 2 summary for your legal/security review (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf).

Short responses and clarifications from our side:
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a current SOC 2 Type II in production for our hosted offering. I’ve included the summary and the control owner contact in the doc. If you need the full report we can arrange an NDA and secure transfer.
- BAA: We do support BAAs for Private/Dedicated deployments and hosted customers with PHI — happy to loop in our legal team. If procurement can share a draft or preferred language, we’ll review pre-signature.
- Telemetry & PII: Our console telemetries are opt-in for debug-level traces and we do not log user-entered PHI by default. We offer automatic redaction rules and customer-configurable retention (default 30 days for ephemeral traces, 90 days for operational logs) — retention windows can be negotiated for enterprise contracts.
- Docs & cookies: Our public docs use only anonymized analytics by default; cookie banners can be configured for enterprise deployments and we offer a cookie-less docs-hosting option on request.

Ethan — can you provide a short tech note we can paste into the questionnaire for the telemetry/retention questions (redwood defaults, redaction approaches, and any available SOC 2 control IDs that map to logging/audit)?

Proposed next steps:
- Ethan to add technical answers into the questionnaire and return the completed PDF to procurement@acmehealth.com by EOD tomorrow.
- I’ll coordinate a legal/procurement call (30–45 min) to run through BAA and SOC 2 report transfer — Claire, what time zone is best for your procurement/legal team?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
